title: Provision scoped service identities for engineering agents
goal: Give each registered engineering agent a revocable, auditable platform identity without sharing human credentials or bypassing authorization

in: Agent identity directory, hashed service credentials, optional Supabase auth-user linkage, provisioning utility, and server-side agent request authentication
out: Human login UX and password recovery
Automatic grants to Admin or organization data
Provisioning real credentials in the current environment

acceptance_criteria: Every registered agent has a durable pending identity with explicit status and metadata
Credentials are stored only as one-way hashes, are revocable and expirable, and raw secrets are never persisted
Server-side request authentication resolves active agent identity and scopes without exposing the service role key
Agent actions can be attributed to both the agent principal and optional Supabase auth user
RLS denies anon/authenticated table access by default and service-role writes are explicit
Focused auth tests and migration validation pass; no live credential is provisioned automatically

evidence: Focused ESLint passed for agent auth core, server helper, provisioning utility, and tests.
Migration validation passed, including 20260908130000_agent_service_identities.sql with planned manifest.
Control-plane validation passed: 17 agents, 4 tasks, 0 warnings/errors.
No live credential was provisioned; Supabase CLI migration creation was attempted but blocked by sandbox telemetry permissions.

progress.summary: Implemented the additive service-principal foundation for all registered engineering agents without provisioning live credentials.
completed: Added 17 pending agent identities with explicit status, role, scope, and optional auth-user linkage.
Added server-only hashed-key authentication, scope checks, audit attribution, and one-time provisioning utility.
Added RLS-denied credential and audit tables plus migration validation manifest.
Added focused credential extraction, hashing, constant-time verification, and scope tests.
next_steps: Apply the migration in an isolated Supabase environment and verify RLS/grants with security advisors.
Provision one explicitly approved non-production agent and wire its first route through authenticateAgentRequest.
